mentions.name: FreeBSD 14.4
mentions.description: The FreeBSD 14.4 release of the open-source FreeBSD operating system. The release is complete and being propagated to mirrors and cloud providers, with a release announcement email being prepared for distribution.
mentions.source_excerpt: Writing the release announcement for FreeBSD 14.4!  The release is ready (aside from propagating to mirrors and clouds) but I have until 2026-03-10 00:00 UTC to get the announcement email ready to go out.
